dakshaEventsData.title: Launchpad
dakshaEventsData.description: Think you have an idea worth betting on? Shark Tank | Daksha 2026 is now open for registrations!  Pitch your idea, challenge your thinking and put your vision to the test and if it's good enough win upto ₹50,000. Your idea. Your pitch. Your shot. Registrations are now OPEN! Dive in.
